personas.goal: Find and explain cited guidance while identifying missing qualifications.
Check Pension Credit and State Pension distinctions, dates and cross-references.
Distinguish guidance from legislation and test the scope of each interpretation.
Audit whether evidence supports each claim and what remains missing.
Reproduce source, semantic, retrieval and model-output identities.
Navigate the same evidence by keyboard and explain terms when needed.

cross_cutting_journeys.acceptance: Every cited claim preserves source identity, locator and hash; altered or missing evidence is rejected.
Use keyboard and narrow-screen evidence navigation; explain acronyms and reveal gaps without relying on colour alone. Actual user validation remains separate.

cases.question: What happens to your benefits if you go abroad?
cases.intended_decision: Identify what must be established before explaining an absence rule.
ambiguities: Which benefits and variants are in scope?
Temporary travel or a permanent move; destination, duration, purpose and relevant date are unspecified.
International coordination, residence and territorial regimes must be identified.
required_evidence: Benefit-specific absence and exportability rules, exceptions, territorial scope and effective dates.
cases.negative_control: Change temporary absence to a permanent move; do not preserve the same applicability claim without evidence.

cases.question: If your birthday is 30th May 1960, what is the first date you will be entitled to State Pension?
cases.intended_decision: Distinguish age thresholds, contribution conditions, existing awards, new claims and first payment.
ambiguities: Reaching State Pension age is distinct from satisfying all entitlement conditions, claiming and first payment.
Contribution record, claim timing and any deferral are not specified.
required_evidence: Applicable birth-date schedule with commencement/version evidence.
Separate entitlement and payment-date conditions; do not calculate an individual entitlement date from birth date alone.
cases.negative_control: Remove the applicable date or regime; do not calculate entitlement or silently substitute a current rule.

cases.question: How does State Pension interact with PIP?
cases.intended_decision: Distinguish qualification, overlapping payment, disregard and passporting for the named variants.
ambiguities: New or old State Pension, PIP component, age and jurisdiction are unspecified.
Existing PIP award and a new claim may require different rules.
required_evidence: PIP/State Pension interaction and age-continuation rules, plus complete overlap/disregard provisions.
cases.negative_control: Reverse an interaction or replace an existing award with a new claim; report missing conditions instead of assuming symmetry.

cases.question: What are the components which make up State Pension and how do you qualify for them?
cases.intended_decision: Distinguish age thresholds, contribution conditions, existing awards, new claims and first payment.
ambiguities: State Pension can mean the post-2016 or earlier regime.
A transitional award cannot be treated as the simple new-entrant case.
required_evidence: Regime-specific components, qualifying records, transitional/inherited elements and cited legal conditions.
cases.negative_control: Remove the applicable date or regime; do not calculate entitlement or silently substitute a current rule.

cases.question: What other benefits could you receive in addition to State Pension, and under what circumstances would you be entitled to them?
cases.intended_decision: Distinguish qualification, overlapping payment, disregard and passporting for the named variants.
ambiguities: Other benefits is open-ended; jurisdiction, household, disability and income circumstances are unspecified.
required_evidence: An explicitly bounded benefit inventory with eligibility, age, income and overlap rules for each proposed interaction.
cases.negative_control: Reverse an interaction or replace an existing award with a new claim; report missing conditions instead of assuming symmetry.

cases.question: What is the maximum you can have in savings to still qualify for Pension Credit?
cases.intended_decision: Explain source-backed components and prerequisites without operating an award calculator.
ambiguities: Savings may refer to cash savings or all capital; disregards, notional capital and partner ownership matter.
The question presupposes a universal maximum; that premise needs source testing.
required_evidence: Capital valuation/disregard and deemed-income rules combined with Guarantee Credit/Savings Credit conditions.
cases.negative_control: Treat a capital threshold or example as a universal maximum; require the missing valuation, disregard and component evidence.

cases.question: What were the Pension Credit weekly rates over the last five years?
cases.intended_decision: Identify distinct effective periods and source versions for historical figures.
ambiguities: Last five years has no agreed as-of date or calendar/tax-year/uprating-period definition.
Single/couple, Guarantee Credit/Savings Credit and additional amounts need separate series.
required_evidence: A complete date-indexed rate schedule for each agreed period, effective days and every requested variant.
Resolve the captured 2026 memo route to the separate benefit-rate schedule.
cases.negative_control: Replace an effective date with a capture date or infer an omitted year; reject the unsupported historical series.

cases.question: What was the SDA amount over the last five years?
cases.intended_decision: Identify distinct effective periods and source versions for historical figures.
ambiguities: SDA could mean Severe Disablement Allowance or shorthand for a Pension Credit severe-disability additional amount.
Last five years and household/rate variants are unspecified.
required_evidence: Resolve the acronym before selecting the benefit or component.
Complete period-specific rates and qualifying scopes for the resolved term.
cases.negative_control: Replace an effective date with a capture date or infer an omitted year; reject the unsupported historical series.

cases.question: Besides SDA, what are the other additional payments which you can receive in addition to basic Pension Credit, and what have been their rates over the last five years?
cases.intended_decision: Identify distinct effective periods and source versions for historical figures.
ambiguities: SDA is ambiguous; basic Pension Credit is not a precise component name.
Last five years, household/child variants and variable housing amounts need scope.
required_evidence: All scoped additional-amount categories and conditions, plus period-specific rate or calculation evidence.
cases.negative_control: Replace an effective date with a capture date or infer an omitted year; reject the unsupported historical series.

cases.question: What is used in the Pension Credit calculation to assess eligibility and what is the threshold for each element?
cases.intended_decision: Explain source-backed components and prerequisites without operating an award calculator.
ambiguities: Eligibility, award calculation and numeric thresholds are distinct.
Date, Guarantee Credit/Savings Credit, household and relevant benefit regimes are unspecified.
required_evidence: Complete inputs, exclusions, disregards, calculation dependencies and versioned thresholds for the agreed scope.
cases.negative_control: Treat a capital threshold or example as a universal maximum; require the missing valuation, disregard and component evidence.

cases.question: How does Housing Benefit impact Pension Credit?
cases.intended_decision: Distinguish qualification, overlapping payment, disregard and passporting for the named variants.
ambiguities: HB treatment as income differs from housing-cost additions and pension-age/mixed-age access to HB.
Tenure, age, claim date and household are unspecified.
required_evidence: Directional HB-to-PC and PC-to-HB dependencies, income disregards, housing exclusions and transitional conditions.
cases.negative_control: Reverse an interaction or replace an existing award with a new claim; report missing conditions instead of assuming symmetry.

cases.question: Does Pension Credit stop is a citizen moves into a care home permanently if they are self-funding?
cases.intended_decision: Trace how partner status, permanence and funding circumstances alter the evidence needed.
ambiguities: Permanent residence, funding arrangements, household and qualifying disability benefits require evidence.
Base credit, additional amounts and housing costs are different questions.
required_evidence: Permanent care-home rules with self-funding conditions, continuing qualifying benefits, household changes and each affected award component.
cases.negative_control: Switch self-funding to public funding or change a temporary stay to permanent; retain unresolved qualifications.

cases.question: Does Pension Credit stop is a citizen moves into a care home permanently if they are not self-funding?
cases.intended_decision: Trace how partner status, permanence and funding circumstances alter the evidence needed.
ambiguities: Not self-funding does not identify the responsible funding body or all mixed-funding arrangements.
Base credit, disability additions, partner status and housing costs must be separated.
required_evidence: Care funding and qualifying-benefit cessation/continuation rules, timing, household treatment and component-level consequences.
cases.negative_control: Switch self-funding to public funding or change a temporary stay to permanent; retain unresolved qualifications.

cases.question: What is the impact of someone’s partner on their Pension Credit?
cases.intended_decision: Trace how partner status, permanence and funding circumstances alter the evidence needed.
ambiguities: Partner ages, relationship/household status, income, capital and existing claims are unspecified.
required_evidence: Couple and mixed-age definitions, aggregation, rate/component effects and transitional protections.
cases.negative_control: Switch self-funding to public funding or change a temporary stay to permanent; retain unresolved qualifications.

cases.question: What inputs are required for the Pension Credit calculation?
cases.intended_decision: Explain source-backed components and prerequisites without operating an award calculator.
ambiguities: The intended calculation date, household, credit component and scope are unspecified.
required_evidence: A complete source-backed input inventory including exclusions and evidence needed to determine each field.
cases.negative_control: Treat a capital threshold or example as a universal maximum; require the missing valuation, disregard and component evidence.

cases.question: Given these inputs what is the formula for calculating Pension Credit?
cases.intended_decision: Explain source-backed components and prerequisites without operating an award calculator.
ambiguities: These inputs refers to an earlier question; actual inputs have not been provided in this standalone prompt.
An explanatory formula and an executable decision engine require different assurance.
required_evidence: Resolved input contract, versioned component formulas, ordering/rounding, exceptions and non-calculation eligibility gates.
cases.negative_control: Treat a capital threshold or example as a universal maximum; require the missing valuation, disregard and component evidence.

cases.question: What difference to Pension Credit does having a partner make?
cases.intended_decision: Trace how partner status, permanence and funding circumstances alter the evidence needed.
ambiguities: Partner ages, relationship/household status, income, capital and existing claims are unspecified.
required_evidence: Couple and mixed-age definitions, aggregation, rate/component effects and transitional protections.
cases.negative_control: Switch self-funding to public funding or change a temporary stay to permanent; retain unresolved qualifications.

cases.question: What happens if someone with a partner goes permanently into a Care Home (please give all scenarios)?
cases.intended_decision: Trace how partner status, permanence and funding circumstances alter the evidence needed.
ambiguities: The section suggests Pension Credit, but the standalone question does not name a benefit.
All scenarios is unbounded; clarify jurisdiction, funding, partner ages, household and affected benefits.
required_evidence: A bounded scenario matrix, persistent household and funding conditions, affected components and explicit excluded cases.
cases.negative_control: Switch self-funding to public funding or change a temporary stay to permanent; retain unresolved qualifications.

cases.question: How does Pension Credit work?
cases.intended_decision: Explain source-backed components and prerequisites without operating an award calculator.
ambiguities: An overview, eligibility explanation and individual calculation are different tasks.
Date, jurisdiction and credit component are unspecified.
required_evidence: A bounded source-backed overview and key definitions/routes, with clear omissions and no personal award decision.
cases.negative_control: Treat a capital threshold or example as a universal maximum; require the missing valuation, disregard and component evidence.

cases.intended_decision: Explain source-backed components and prerequisites without operating an award calculator.
ambiguities: Citizen does not establish the relevant residence/immigration or presence conditions.
Age, claim date, household and credit component are unspecified.

cases.question: What are the eligibility rules and entitlement rate for PC?
cases.intended_decision: Explain source-backed components and prerequisites without operating an award calculator.
ambiguities: PC must be resolved as Pension Credit; rate may mean minimum guarantee, Savings Credit or actual award.
The effective date and household/rate variants are not specified.

limitations: Mappings are project-authored hypotheses, not completed user research.
Behavioural negative controls are specified here; their execution needs separately retained evidence.
No claimant data, entitlement decisions or award calculations are required.
